title: Circuit current correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the current using Ohm's Law for a closed circuit: I = E/(R + r).

title: Terminal voltage correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the terminal voltage using U = I * R (the external resistance).

title: Output power correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the output power using P_out = U * I.

title: Total power correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the total power using P_total = E * I.

title: Applies Ohm's Law
description: Important: Student identifies and applies the correct form of Ohm's law for the entire circuit and for the terminal voltage.

title: Distinguishes power types
description: Important: Student distinguishes between the power supply's total power (EI) and its output power (UI).

title: Includes unit analysis
description: Optional: Student includes or checks units (A, V, W) in their calculations.

title: Confuses R for terminal voltage
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses the internal resistance 'r' or total resistance 'R+r' when calculating terminal voltage U.

title: Misidentifies power formulas
description: Pitfall: Student confuses the formulas for output power (UI) and total power (EI), swapping them.
